lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Huff... huff... The nightmare is fading... Did I actually break through your genjutsu?

lines.speaker: Itachi
lines.text: Impressive. Very few possess the will to shatter my illusions and stand upright.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Look behind you. The seal on that massive ancient gate just shattered.

lines.speaker: Itachi
lines.text: Then your path is clear. You have proven that your truth is stronger than the darkness within this maze.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Thanks for the trial, Itachi. I'm taking the leap to the next realm.

lines.speaker: Itachi
lines.text: Go forth, and remember: never lose sight of who you are, no matter how deep the abyss gets.
